priorityList: Use Mutilate as your single-target builder and Envenom as your single-target spender.
Maintain Rupture and Garrote at all times.
Use Kingsbane and Deathmark on cooldown.
Apply Vanish-empowered Garrote before using Deathmark.
Use Thistle Tea alongside Kingsbane to avoid overcapping charges.
Maintain Garrote on the target at all times.
Maintain Rupture with 5 or more Combo Points.
Cast Kingsbane on cooldown, ideally synced with Deathmark and Shiv windows.
Cast Shiv during Kingsbane to maximize Nature damage amplification.
Cast Envenom with 5 or more Combo Points to maximize Envenom buff uptime and trigger Hand of Fate coin flips.
Cast Vanish on cooldown to apply an empowered Garrote.
Cast Mutilate as your primary Combo Point generator.
Use Thistle Tea if Energy falls below 30 or to provide a Mastery buff during your burst window.
